desc:
⚽ Welcome to Impress Your Favorite Soccer Player!

How to play:
🚪 Knock on a soccer player's door!
🔥 Impress them with your best tricks!
⚽ Steal their ball and bring it back to your base!
🎁 Open balls to unlock soccer players!
💰 Sell soccer players to earn money!
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill, ball-handling techniques, and speed auras!
✨ Discover rarer balls and legendary soccer players!
📖 Complete the collection index and claim rewards!

💸 Earn money while offline 💸

🎮 Supported on desktop, mobile, tablet, and console
